description: Per-campaign competition on a targeted keyword across the whole marketplace for one period: every campaign that served the given keyword, with currency-converted spend and attributed sales plus impressions and clicks, broken out by campaign identity (campaign_id, campaign_name, effective_status, campaign_creation_date), advertiser os_client_id, and seller_id. The keyword is a mandatory per-call filter. CTR/CPC/CPM/ROI and spend-share/contribution are derived downstream from these raw aggregates.

keyword.description: The matched targeted keyword (lowercased). Mandatory filter: the keyword whose marketplace-wide campaign competition to report.

campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign_id (lowercased) of a campaign competing on the keyword.

campaign_name.description: Display name (alias) of the competing marketing campaign.

effective_status.description: Effective status of the competing campaign (ACTIVE / PAUSED / ...).

campaign_creation_date.description: Creation date of the competing campaign; used downstream to flag new entrants within the reporting window.

os_client_id.description: Advertiser client_id owning the competing campaign.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Campaign ad spend on the keyword over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions the campaign served for this keyword.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks (visits) the campaign received for this keyword.

attributed_sales.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.program_per_click_timestamp_sales * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
attributed_sales.description: Per-click-timestamp attributed sales for this keyword+campaign, converted to the marketplace currency. ROI is derived downstream as attributed_sales / spend.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_keyword_performance_report` AS k INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON ctd.account_id = k.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = k.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = k.client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.marketplace_client_id = k.marketplace_client_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS cl ON cl.client_id = k.client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = k.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND (mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
